name: Ba'Har
description: Ba'Har was a planet located within the Coyn system of the Outer Rim Territories. The name "Ba'Har" meant "Battle Blade" in the Coynite language. Ba'Har was a multicolored gas giant with a small band of rings, the remains of a moon torn apart by gravitational stresses.
